node.title: Re^2: transferring \n to linux from perl via serial port
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Just a guess, and I have no configuration to test with currently, but try sending \r\n and see if that helps.

Sorry, I think that's unlikely to help, as on Windows, that will cause \r\r\n to be transmitted - see [id://11124354|my post].
